#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long mod = 998244353;

long long powmod(long long a, long long b) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

struct Matrix {
    long long a, b, c, d;
    Matrix(long long a = 0, long long b = 0, long long c = 0, long long d = 0) : a(a % mod), b(b % mod), c(c % mod), d(d % mod) {}
    Matrix operator*(const Matrix& o) const {
        return Matrix(
            (a * o.a + b * o.c) % mod,
            (a * o.b + b * o.d) % mod,
            (c * o.a + d * o.c) % mod,
            (c * o.b + d * o.d) % mod
        );
    }
    Matrix pow(long long e) const {
        Matrix res(1, 0, 0, 1), base = *this;
        while (e > 0) {
            if (e & 1) res = res * base;
            base = base * base;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    long long n, m, L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;
    n %= mod; m %= mod; // not actually needed for exponent, we use n*m as exponent
    
    if (n % 2 == 1 && m % 2 == 1) {
        cout << powmod((R - L + 1) % mod, n * m) << '\n';
    } else {
        long long cnt = R - L + 1;
        if (cnt % 2 == 0) {
            long long allbutone = powmod(cnt % mod, n * m - 1);
            cout << allbutone * (cnt / 2) % mod << '\n';
        } else {
            long long k = cnt / 2;
            Matrix mat(k, k + 1, k + 1, k);
            Matrix res = mat.pow(n * m);
            cout << res.a << '\n';
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
